text.title: 同一本笔记中的两幅图
text.goal: 同一本笔记中的两幅图
text.situation:
乔在安静桌上打开笔记。一幅图以直线展示线性关系；标签说明两个量成比例，所以在该例中，一个加倍，另一个也加倍。单位卡说明一米等于一百厘米。下一页，玛雅找到这次展览和工作坊参观的相似特点：两者都使用需要解释的模型。这里是两次参观的共同点，而不是之前移动的平行线。乔画箭头指回工作坊那页。

玛雅：所有直线关系都成比例吗？
讲解员：不是，这个例子过原点，但其他直线未必。
乔：我看到它与工作坊有个相似特点。
玛雅：两者都让我们不要只看模型本身。

paragraphs.en: Jo opened her notebook on a quiet table. One diagram showed a linear relationship as a straight line. A label said that the two quantities were proportional, so doubling one doubled the other in that example. A unit card explained that one metre is equivalent to one hundred centimetres. On the next page, Maya found a parallel between this exhibition and their workshop visit: both used models that needed explanation. This was a shared feature of two visits, rather than one of the parallel lines they had moved earlier. Jo drew an arrow back to the workshop page.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: Are all straight-line relationships proportional?
Guide: No. This example passes through the origin, but other straight lines need not.
Jo: I can see a parallel with the workshop.
Maya: Both asked us to look beyond the model itself.
